'''Holotexts''' were a form of information storage. Members of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] team that encountered the [[Alderaanian War Frigate]] ''[[Another Chance]]'' in [[the Graveyard]] recognized the vessel from seeing the design in holotexts.
